subject: Request: Executive signoff for 30% Hosted API concession — Zenara Health

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@zenarahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@zenarahealth.com>
Subject: Request: Executive signoff for 30% Hosted API concession — Zenara Health

Team — looping you in on an urgent concession ask from Zenara. Quick summary: they
are piloting our Hosted API across two EHR integrations and want a steep initial rate
for go-live economics. High-level:
- Current ask: 30% off list Hosted API usage rate for first 12 months (then step-up).
- Committed spend (requested): $1.2M over 12 months (volume ramp tied to go-live dates).
- Strategic value: multi-hospital system, strong public case-study potential, and
  potential expansion to Dedicated in 2027.

I've attached the latest proposal and the pricing model the customer sent and our
updated numbers (Zenara_RateProposal_v3.pdf, zenara-pricing-model.xlsx). They
explicitly asked for a decision this week to align with their procurement cycle.

Why I am escalating: our concession framework caps unapproved discounts above 20% —
this is a 30% ask and they are pressing for an answer because of procurement deadlines.
They've indicated sensitivity to price vs competitor X. Losing momentum now risks
losing the pilot.

Requested action: can I get an exec signoff (Ben/Mina/Marcus) to approve up to 30%
concession, or sign off a counter that we should present to Zenara (e.g., 22–25%)?
If approved, I will send a revised term sheet and request Legal/Deal Desk to prepare
DocuSign.

Notes/constraints I recommend be attached to any approval:
- 12-month committed minimum ($1.2M) with monthly cadence and clawback if underuse
- Public case study and co-marketing commitment from Zenara (PR/quote) for >25%
- Standard Redwood MSA + SOC2 evidence; no data residency exceptions requested so far

Thanks — appreciate quick thoughts.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: Zenara_RateProposal_v3.pdf (proposal, 4 pages), zenara-pricing-model.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@zenarahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@zenarahealth.com>
Subject: Re: Request: Executive signoff for 30% Hosted API concession — Zenara Health

Thanks for the concise background, Neha. Quick thoughts: we generally need senior approval
for discounts >20% — that's why you escalated. From a revenue-risk perspective I don't
love 30% off list as a baseline unless the commitment and legal protections are
very tight.

Proposed path:
1) Offer a firm 22% for the first 6 months, with pre-agreed ramp milestones that unlock
   an additional 3% (to 25%) at month 7 if usage >= 85% of committed tokens.
2) Require the $1.2M 12-month minimum, invoiced monthly and a clause for clawback on
   shortfall.
3) Make co-marketing/case study a gating condition for >25%.

If Finance (Marcus) and Mina are comfortable with the above structure, I can put
this in front of them as a recommended counter — it reduces immediate revenue risk
and gives the customer a path to the deeper concession.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Neha / Ben — I reviewed the attached model and the likely expansion cadence. High level:
- I can support a concession up to 25% with the following firm conditions:
  * $1.2M committed spend over 12 months (no partial acceptance)
  * Usage milestones (month 3 & month 6) with objective thresholds; if missed,
    rate reverts to list and outstanding credits clawed back
  * Full co-marketing commitment (case study/webinar + customer quote) signed in
    the SOW/attachment
  * Legal to confirm no non-standard data residency or indemnity clauses in the final MSA

25% gives us flexibility and preserves a path to 30% only if there is additional exec
justification (senior revenue impact + strategic board-level rationale).

Neha — can you capture those conditions in a revised term sheet and send to Legal
and Marcus for the finance check? If Marcus signs off on cashflow/credit risk I'll
greenlight 25% and we can ask for the extra 5% later only on extraordinary grounds.

Mina
Mina Haddad

Team — reviewed the numbers and the proposed guardrails. Finance is OK to approve
a 25% Hosted API concession for Zenara Health under the exact conditions Mina
outlined. I am attaching the signed internal approval form (internal-approval-marcus-20260919.pdf).

Conditions for approval (final):
- 25% off list Hosted API usage rates for months 1–12
- $1.2M minimum committed value over 12 months, invoiced monthly; payment
  terms: Net 30.
- Usage milestones at month 3 and month 6 (>= 85% of projected tokens) or
  clawback applies per the term sheet.
- Customer to commit to a public case study + quote in the SOW to unlock any
  further discounting beyond 25%.
- Legal to confirm standard MSA and SOC2 evidence. No custom data residency
  exceptions approved.

Neha/Ben — this is my signoff. Proceed to issue the revised term sheet to Zenara
and instruct Deal Desk/Legal to prepare DocuSign. Finance will flag the deal
in billing as an approved concession (use internal code: FIN-APP-25-ZEN).
